We Got Another Year - Chapter 1:Lonely (2023-2024)
Roberto is great at juggling college, friends, and work, but when a chance at romance presents itself, it threatens to risk the balance he's worked very hard to achieve.

We Got Another Year - Chapter 2:Blistered Hands (2024)
Roberto and Matthew have found a bit of common ground, but more obstacles show up, along with the uncertainty that they’ll be able to maintain an amicable relationship after all is said and done.
Title is based off of Blistered Hands by The Reign of Kindo, you can check it out here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fKmqQC7cf4

We Got Another Year - Chapter 3:If I Ever Feel Better (2024-2025)
Through pain and heartaches, Roberto and Matthew figure out their differences and work together through trauma and their past, but some wounds leave scars too deep to heal by themselves.
Title is based off of If I Ever Feel Better by Phoenix, you can check it out here: https://youtu.be/LZlGqWpCF58

We Got Another Year - Chapter 4:Seed Of Gold (2025)
When challenges become too big for any one person, Matthew and Roberto find comfort and strength in one another, learning to work together to overcome what once felt impossible and through that, finding new possibilities that never even crossed their minds.
Title is based off of Seeds of Gold by Closure in Moscow, you can check it out here: https://youtu.be/4ZseL6VyddQ
